name: kespay
description: Kenyan digital wallet & social payments platform — DEMO MODE, NO REAL MONEY.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @app/shared" "npm run dev -w @app/server" "npm run dev -w @app/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @app/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @app/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run build -w @app/server && npm run build -w @app/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @app/server && npm run typecheck -w @app/client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @app/server
